name: Chord
description: Hosted MCP server for Chord, a non-custodial DEX aggregator and on-chain data index. Best-route DEX swap quotes and unsigned swap transactions on 7 EVM chains (Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, Arc), plus market data: token boards, search, candles, trades, wallet PnL, smart money, holders and LP pools (Solana data is read-only). 17 tools; 16 need no key (about 60 requests a minute), only chord_ask needs a Chord API key. Swap tools return unsigned transactions for the user's wallet to sign. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.getchordlabs/chord.
author: Chord
